page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a left margin holding the years and the heading "An. Christi", and a right margin holding line numbers. The running head and page number are at the top, and the catchword is at the bottom right.

main_text.p: An. Christiigni & sanguine permixtam, h. e. turbulentum in-genium Phocæ, Papæ Bonifacii III. & Mahome-dis, qui tres constituunt Cerberum tricipitem, ex quo aliquot flammæ noxiæ prosilierunt, ab anno 606 ad 650.5
650.Secunda tuba corrupit mare, id est, doctrinam euangelii in oriente & occidente variis corruptelis infecit, ab an. 650 ad 730.
730.Tertia tuba introduxit abfinthium disputationum idololatricarum, ab anno 730 ad 800.10
800.Quarta tuba peperit eclipsin solis, lunæ, & stellarum, i. e. donorum ecclesiasticorum.
1073.Quinta tuba produxit locustas otiosas & inutiles, i. e. varios monachorum ordines.

1140.Sexta tuba genuit equites, h. e. prælatos eccle-siasticos, qui secularibus delectantur, & sunt velut equites in regno antichristi. His adde Summi-stas, Scholasticos, & alios parasitos curiæ Romanæ.15
main_text.head: Nonum interuallum, inde ab anno Christi 1359 ad an. 1694.20[?]
main_text.p: 1359.Septima tuba sonuit tempore Petrarchæ, Wiclefi, Huffi, & aliorum, qui bestiæ cotradixerunt, ab an. 1359 ad an. 1517.25

1517.Septem phialæ effunduntur: e quib. prima, circa an. Chr. 1517. super terram effudit ulcus malum & noxium: prædicatione euangelii excitando pessima animorum ulcera, iram, odium, livorem, furorem, in antichristi ministris, adversus euangelium, eiusque confessores, qui variis ulceribus, h. e. plagis sunt affecti ob constantem suam confessionem.30
1545.Secunda phiala effudit super mare, h. e. doctrinam euangelii, colluviem concil. Trid.35

page.notes: Left margin reads "An. Christi" at the top and the years 650, 730, 800, 1073, 1140, 1359, 1517, 1545 down the margin. Right margin line numbers are 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35; the number after the Nonum heading (read as 20) and the one at "ab an. 1359" (read as 25) are uncertain. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, so "Chrifti" is "Christi" and "eft" is "est". Catchword "Tertia" is in italic at the bottom right. No separate footnotes are printed.
